answer: Sybil proofs arrive as onyx pages written on cedar panels, their copper circuits etched by the agent’s keystrokes. Each new identity must carve a fresh panel from the same tree, its grain changing under the blade; timing the cut burns a unique cell in the agent’s local chrono-cell. Cost: per Sybil a panel’s copper alloy ingot and one second of irreplaceable carver-time, since the panel’s grain resists forge lasers.
